title: A Bridge for the Typewriter
author: Kestrel Winterbourne
blurb: Coral Okafor, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the census taker asks one question too many, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
